title: depositFor missing require(credited > 0) guard
description: depositFor (L516-537) lacks the require(credited > 0) guard present in stake (L250). A dust deposit via a haircutting strategy yields credited == 0, polluting the _stakers set with a zero-position user (inflating getStakers / stakerCount / migration batch size). No fund loss; caller is the trusted migrator.
impact: No fund loss. A zero-position user can be inserted into the _stakers set, inflating getStakers, stakerCount, and migration batch size. Bounded by trusted-migrator caller.
attackPath: Trusted migrator calls depositFor with a dust amount while a haircutting strategy is active.
strategy.deposit credits credited == 0 for the dust amount.
depositFor has no require(credited > 0) guard, so the zero-position user is added to the _stakers set.
getStakers / stakerCount / migration batch size are inflated by the zero-position entry.
recommendation: Mirror stake's require(credited > 0) guard in depositFor.
